tagline: A still bottom and a strong drive out of the hole.

videos.title: The Paused Squat: Gym Shorts (How To)

coaching.summary: Squat to your normal depth, hold still at the bottom for a count of two while staying tight, then drive back up.
cues: Stay braced through the whole pause so the bottom position stays tight.
Hold the bottom still, without bouncing or drifting forward.
Drive out of the pause with the hips and chest rising together.

standardsRef.note: The pause takes away the bounce, so most lifters use a little less than their squat.
